A '''settlement''' existed on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ragmar V]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] around [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. Its population consisted of outcasts of various [[Species/Legends|species]], including [[Human/Legends|Humans]], [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinians]], [[Bith/Legends|Bith]], [[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]], [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorians]], [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorreans]], [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]], [[Nuknog/Legends|Nuknogs]], and [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronians]]. The settlement's leader was a Human named [[Gaan]].
